endpoints.name: Account Profile
endpoints.description: The Keap account's own details -- company name, address, currency and time zone. One record.

endpoints.name: Commissions
endpoints.description: Affiliate commissions earned, filterable by date. Requires the affiliate programme to be in use. What partners are owed, which appears nowhere in the order table.

endpoints.name: Affiliate Model
endpoints.description: The schema of the affiliate object.

endpoints.name: Appointments
endpoints.description: Calendar appointments, filterable by date range. Carries the contact, times, location and remind time.

endpoints.name: Appointment
endpoints.description: One appointment by id.

endpoints.name: Appointment Model
endpoints.description: The schema of the appointment object.

endpoints.name: Campaigns
endpoints.description: The marketing campaigns -- Keap's automation sequences -- filterable by search text. Carries the name, the goals and sequences within, and the counts of contacts active in each. WHERE AUTOMATION LIVES: contacts move through these based on tags and behaviour, and the active counts are the closest thing to a funnel state for the business.

endpoints.name: Campaign
endpoints.description: One campaign by id, with its sequences and goals.

endpoints.name: Companies
endpoints.description: The companies contacts belong to, filterable by name. The organisation dimension.

endpoints.name: Company Model
endpoints.description: The schema of the company object, including custom fields.

endpoints.name: Contacts
endpoints.description: The contacts in the account, filterable by email, given name and family name. Carries names, email addresses and phone numbers as ARRAYS of labelled entries rather than single values, addresses, the owner, the source, tags, and custom fields. The central table of a Keap account. Note optional_properties: several useful fields -- custom fields among them -- are omitted unless named there, so their absence is often an unmade request rather than empty data.

endpoints.name: Credit Cards
endpoints.description: The payment cards stored on one contact. Requires a contact id. Metadata only; card numbers are not returned.

endpoints.name: Contact Emails
endpoints.description: The email addresses on one contact. Requires a contact id.

endpoints.name: Applied Tags
endpoints.description: The tags applied to one contact. Requires a contact id. Tags in Keap are the primary segmentation mechanism -- automation is driven by them -- so a contact's tags say more about where they sit in the business than any status field.

endpoints.name: Contact
endpoints.description: One contact by id, with the same optional_properties behaviour.

endpoints.name: Contact Model
endpoints.description: The schema of the contact object -- every field including custom ones, with its type and options. THE DECODER, and Keap gives every major object one of these model endpoints, which is the pattern to reach for whenever a custom field appears.

endpoints.name: Orders
endpoints.description: The orders placed, filterable by date range, contact and product. Carries the contact, order items, total, status and the date. The commerce side of Keap, distinct from opportunities: an opportunity is a forecast, an order is money owed.

endpoints.name: Order
endpoints.description: One order by id, with its line items.

endpoints.name: Order Transactions
endpoints.description: The payments applied against one order. Requires an order id. The order carries a total; this says when and whether money actually arrived.

endpoints.name: Custom Order Model
endpoints.description: The schema of the order object, including custom fields.

endpoints.name: Subscriptions
endpoints.description: The recurring billing subscriptions, optionally for one contact. Carries the product, billing cycle, amount and status. Recurring revenue, which the order table records only as individual charges.

endpoints.name: Subscription Model
endpoints.description: The schema of the subscription object.

endpoints.name: Transactions
endpoints.description: All payment transactions across the account, filterable by date and contact. The account-wide cash view, as opposed to the per-order one.

endpoints.name: Transaction
endpoints.description: One transaction by id.

endpoints.name: Emails
endpoints.description: The emails sent to contacts, filterable by contact, address and sent date. The record of what was actually delivered, as opposed to the campaign that intended it.

endpoints.name: Email
endpoints.description: One email by id, with its content and headers.

endpoints.name: Files
endpoints.suffix: /v1/files?viewable={Viewable?:PUBLIC | PRIVATE | BOTH}&permission={Permission?:USER | COMPANY | BOTH}&type={Type?:Application | Image | Fax | ... }&name={Name?}&contact_id={Contact ID}
endpoints.description: The files stored, filterable by visibility and permission. Metadata; contents are a separate fetch.

endpoints.name: File
endpoints.description: One file by id.

endpoints.name: Countries
endpoints.description: The country list Keap accepts. Reference data.

endpoints.name: Country's Provinces
endpoints.description: The provinces or states of one country. Requires the country code.

endpoints.name: Merchants
endpoints.description: The payment gateways configured. Which processor a transaction went through, and the explanation for a payment method that is unavailable.

endpoints.name: Notes
endpoints.description: Notes recorded against contacts, filterable by user and contact. The qualitative record.

endpoints.name: Note
endpoints.description: One note by id.

endpoints.name: Note Model
endpoints.description: The schema of the note object.

endpoints.name: Opportunities
endpoints.description: The sales opportunities, filterable by owner, stage and search term. Carries the contact, the stage, estimated close date, value and probability. The pipeline table.

endpoints.name: Opportunity
endpoints.description: One opportunity by id.

endpoints.name: Opportunity Model
endpoints.description: The schema of the opportunity object.

endpoints.name: Opportunity Stage Pipelines
endpoints.description: The pipelines and their stages, in order. The dimension a funnel breakdown joins to, and the decoder for the stage id on an opportunity.

endpoints.name: Products
endpoints.description: The product catalogue, filterable by active state, with price, SKU and description.

endpoints.name: Product
endpoints.description: One product by id.

endpoints.name: Product Subscription
endpoints.description: One subscription plan on one product. Requires both ids. The recurring offer attached to a product.

endpoints.name: Synced Products
endpoints.description: Products changed since a sync token was issued. Requires the token. The incremental-sync route for the catalogue, which the plain listing cannot provide.

endpoints.name: Hook Event Types
endpoints.description: The event types a webhook can subscribe to. Reference data.

endpoints.name: Hook Subscriptions
endpoints.description: The webhooks registered by the calling application, with the events each subscribes to. Note it lists this application's hooks, not every hook on the account.

endpoints.name: Hook Subscription
endpoints.description: One webhook by key.

endpoints.name: Application Status
endpoints.description: Whether the Keap application is enabled. A health check.

endpoints.name: Contact Types
endpoints.description: The contact option types configured. Reference data for the contact model.

endpoints.name: Tags
endpoints.description: The tags defined, filterable by category and name. Since automation runs on tags, this list is effectively the catalogue of states and segments the business tracks.

endpoints.name: Tag
endpoints.description: One tag by id.

endpoints.name: Tagged Companies
endpoints.description: The companies carrying one tag. Requires a tag id.

endpoints.name: Tagged Contacts
endpoints.description: The contacts carrying one tag. Requires a tag id. The membership behind a segment.

endpoints.name: Tasks
endpoints.suffix: /v1/tasks?contact_id={Contact ID?}&has_due_date={Has Due Date?:true | false}&user_id={User ID?}&since={Since?: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ}&until={Until?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ}&completed={Completed?:true | false}
endpoints.description: The to-dos, filterable by contact, due date presence and completion. Carries the contact, due date, priority and owner.

endpoints.name: Task
endpoints.description: One task by id.

endpoints.name: Task Model
endpoints.description: The schema of the task object.

endpoints.name: Search Tasks
endpoints.suffix: /v1/tasks/search?contact_id={Contact ID?}&has_due_date={Has Due Date?:true | false}&user_id={User ID}&since={Since?: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ}&until={Until?:yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ}&completed={Completed?:true | false}
endpoints.description: Tasks matching search criteria. The filtered route where the plain listing's parameters are insufficient.

endpoints.name: User Info
endpoints.description: The account the credentials belong to. One record, always the caller.

endpoints.name: Users
endpoints.description: The users of the account, optionally including inactive ones. Every record carries an owner, so this is the dimension per-person performance joins to.
